title: Heuristics and Biases in AI Decision-Making: Implications for Responsible AGI

bias_targets.methodology: Administering 1,500 experiments using zero-shot chain-of-thought prompts adapted from human psychological studies to evaluate LLMs across nine specific cognitive biases (Loss Aversion, Sunk Cost Fallacy, Prospect Theory/Risk Aversion, Framing Effect, Halo Effect, Conjunction Fallacy, Bias of Resemblance/Representativeness, and Neglect of Probability). The models' responses were analyzed and categorized as either 'elaborate' (based on statistical reasoning) or 'intuitive' (relying on simplifying heuristics).
